paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for three different consistency methods. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick labels shown from 2 to 8 at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick labels ranging from 20 to 32 at intervals of 2, accompanied by corresponding horizontal dashed gridlines. The plot contains three lines detailed in a legend. The "Consistency-CE" data is represented by a purple dashed line with circular markers, showing a steady upward trend from an initial point at approximately x = 1.0, y = 19.2 to a final point near x = 8.5, y = 31.3. The "Consistency-Uni" data is represented by a green solid line with square markers, which exhibits a steady increase beginning at roughly x = 2.3, y = 25.3 and ending near x = 8.4, y = 32.6. Finally, the "Consistency-Bi" data is depicted as a red solid line with star markers, demonstrating a steady upward trend starting at approximately x = 1.4, y = 25.9 and concluding at roughly x = 8.4, y = 32.5.
